12. Considering the peculiar facts and circumstances of the present case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the Petitioner on bail on the same terms and conditions as has been imposed on the Petitioner vide Order dated 16.04.2024.
15. With these observations, the Petition is disposed of, along with the pending applications, if any.
